title: An AWS OIDC Trust Policy
description: A trust policy that lets a GitHub Actions run assume a role through OpenID Connect and receive short-lived credentials.

steps.description: This is an AWS trust policy. It lets a GitHub Actions run assume a role through OpenID Connect, so the cloud hands out short-lived credentials.
`Principal` names the GitHub OIDC provider, and `Action: sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity` is the call that exchanges the token for credentials.
The `Condition` checks the token's audience and subject. The `sub` is pinned to `repo:<ORG>/<REPO>:environment:production`.
The TODO comment warns you to pin the exact repo and environment, never a wildcard. A loose subject hands production credentials to any repository or branch.
